Journal.title: Journal
Journal.description: User journal entry with client-encrypted ciphertext, AI cognitive reflections, and spatial metadata.

id.description: Unique identifier of the journal entry

userId.description: Firebase UID of the owning user

salt.description: PBKDF2 salt for client key derivation

isEncrypted.description: Flag indicating if content is zero-knowledge encrypted

distressScore.description: Crisis guardrail distress indicator from 0.0 to 1.0

aiSummary.description: Synthesized reflection summary generated by Gemini

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp of creation

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp of update

/users/{userId}/journals/{journalId}.description: Isolated per-user journal repository strictly bounded to request.auth.uid == userId.
